answer: Persistent Compute Receipts: an identity must submit a continuous chain of independently replayable compute receipts from a unique hardware enclave. Each round, a verifier replays a random slice; the lagoon of pending receipts only clears if replay matches. An attacker must provision a real enclave and burn genuine cycles per identity every epoch, not just once. A sparrow of residual error accumulates across rounds, while any nebula of unexplained variance freezes the chain until full re-verification, multiplying sustained hardware and energy cost per sybil.
